designDecision.why: a 75-item backlog with zero decisions suggests the wall itself is the problem, not the individual artifacts
designDecision.behaviour: in focus mode a decision keeps the reviewer on the pending queue and moves to the artifact that took that slot; the status tabs are not switched
designDecision.escape: the list stays one click away (退出逐项) and nothing is hidden from the other tabs

consoleErrors: 404s from the preview endpoint for fixture paths that do not exist on disk; real artifacts resolve normally
